page.overview:
Who is Curtis Soracco?

Curtis Soracco is a human kinfolk and a novice werewolf hunter allied with Shannon McLaughlin, forming The Lupine Hunters. He secretly wishes to become a vampire.

Formerly a grocery store manager, Soracco encountered a badly wounded Shannon McLaughlin on the side of the road after a battle with a lone werewolf. Refusing a hospital, McLaughlin allowed Soracco to take him to a motel and bandage his wounds. After learning about McLaughlin's crusade and witnessing proof the next night, Soracco insisted on joining him due to a childhood fascination with the occult. He remains unaware that he is actually Kinfolk and secretly desires to become a werewolf.

Soracco stands 5 foot 9 inches tall, weighs 220 pounds, and possesses long brown hair. He maintains good physical condition through rigorous daily training administered by McLaughlin and bears a scar on his chest from a battle with a Garou.

While their primary targets are werewolves, Soracco and McLaughlin also attempt to destroy any lone vampires they encounter. If Soracco encounters a vampire on his own, he offers to spare their unlife in exchange for an Embrace, though he still stakes them at the first opportunity if he feels threatened.
